svg.title: Getting started with unwrap
svg.desc: The package guide branches to foundations, setup instructions, and a coding-agent prompt. Treatment groups and continuous predictors lead to circular GLMMs. An illustrative continuous predictor rotates the von Mises mean toward 0° while reducing concentration. Three marked points on the line for density at 0° match the three polar curves. Mixtures lead to the circular mixture GLMM. The final three boxes link to worked examples.

g.text: Set up to run a notebook
